# Libertty ▸ Theme Editor (the Theme Customizer): with Preview on, a color
# changed shows in every window at once, and Preview off shows the files'
# colors again; Revert and Cancel put the theme back; Save & Apply writes a
# theme file of your own and makes it the theme. Runs with a config folder
# of its own (@CFG@): theme = probe-theme (background #112233).
expect-background:#112233
theme-editor:open
theme-editor:set:background=#203040
expect-background:#203040
# The picker: Background at L 0.2, C 0.02, H 250 is #0f171f.
theme-editor:pick:background
theme-editor:oklch:background=0.2,0.02,250
expect-background:#0f171f
theme-editor:preview:off
expect-background:#112233
theme-editor:preview:on
expect-background:#0f171f
theme-editor:revert
expect-background:#112233
theme-editor:oklch:background=0.2,0.02,250
expect-background:#0f171f
theme-editor:cancel
expect-background:#112233
# Saved: the file (the two new colors too), the config's theme, the windows.
theme-editor:open
theme-editor:oklch:background=0.2,0.02,250
theme-editor:set:1=#ff0000
theme-editor:set:cursor-text=#010203
theme-editor:set:selection-foreground=#fefefe
theme-editor:name:Probe Made
theme-editor:save
wait:0.6
expect-background:#0f171f
type:grep -c 'background = #0f171f' '@CFG@/themes/Probe Made' && grep '^cursor-text\|^selection-fore' '@CFG@/themes/Probe Made' | sed 's/ = /:=/' && grep '^theme' @CFG@/config
key:enter
wait:0.6
expect:cursor-text:=#010203
expect:selection-foreground:=#fefefe
expect:theme = Probe Made
